text:
Coven Academy | Chapter 1 | Disney+
Coven Academy follows three teenage witches and their warlock peers at an elite magic boarding school. In this sneak peek of chapter 1, fiercely independent New Yorker Briar discovers her new school in New Orleans is full of magic as she encounters classmates Tegan and Sasha and begins to suspect her mother’s unsolved murder is connected to this secret world. Watch all episodes of Coven Academy, now streaming on Disney+ and Hulu.
